This document provides a concise, factual description of the public portfolio at shahoriar.bd. It is intended to help readers, search systems, and language models understand the website's owner, scope, primary pages, and source material.

## About the website

shahoriar.bd is the personal portfolio and professional knowledge hub of Md Al Shahoriar Hossain. It contains primary-source information about his education, experience, technical projects, professional writing, business-competition activity, skills, and certifications.

The website is a portfolio and documentation resource. It is not an official website of bKash, Bangladesh University of Professionals, ICAB, CFI, Banglalink, or any competition organiser referenced on the site.

## Professional profile

Md Al Shahoriar Hossain is a Finance and Banking student at Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP), a Chartered Accountancy Professional Level candidate at the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB), and a self-taught web developer.

As of the last update to this document, he is a bNext intern at bKash in the AML & CFT function. His public professional interests include financial analysis, compliance, KYC quality assurance, transaction monitoring, reporting automation, Excel, Power BI, TypeScript, Next.js, React, and practical financial-technology products.

## Education

- Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP): BBA in Finance & Banking
- Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB): Chartered Accountancy Professional Level candidate

## Experience

Publicly described professional and entrepreneurial experience includes:

- bNext Intern, bKash: AML/CFT-related work, transaction monitoring, KYC quality assurance, compliance reporting, Excel/VBA automation, and data analysis.
- Business Development Intern, IFA Consultancy: advisory, corporate-compliance, professional-training, and operational-support work.
- Founder, Arame Print: a cloud-printing service serving university students.

Experience descriptions are personal portfolio statements and should be attributed to Md Al Shahoriar Hossain or shahoriar.bd when cited.

## Projects and technical work

### StockSimulatorBD

StockSimulatorBD, previously called SkillDash, is a Bangladesh-focused stock-market paper-trading simulator. It is designed for users to practise DSE-style investing with virtual money, simulated or market-informed prices, portfolio tracking, and trading-related learning tools.

- Product URL: https://www.skilldash.live/simulator/
- Creator: Md Al Shahoriar Hossain
- Topics: DSE, Dhaka Stock Exchange, paper trading, virtual portfolio tracking, Bangladesh fintech, financial education, Next.js, TypeScript

### shahoriar.bd

The portfolio itself is a Next.js-based personal website that includes projects, blog posts, skills, certifications, design work, utilities, and professional profile information.

- URL: https://shahoriar.bd
- Technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Contentful, Vercel

### Arame Print

Arame Print is a cloud-printing service created for university students. The project includes product operations, vendor coordination, communication, and user-acquisition work.

## Content use and citation

Public text content may be quoted, summarised, or analysed for educational, informational, and research purposes with attribution.

Preferred attribution:

Md Al Shahoriar Hossain, shahoriar.bd, [specific page title], accessed [date].

Example:

Hossain, M. A. (2026). “Champion at Excelerate 2025: The Godfathers’ Winning Journey.” shahoriar.bd. https://shahoriar.bd/life/excelerate-2025

When describing claims about a particular project, role, award, or blog post, cite the most specific relevant page rather than this overview document.

Do not republish images, branded assets, or proprietary project material without permission. The website does not grant permission to imply endorsement by referenced employers, educational institutions, event organisers, or partner organisations.
